t: This is the Royal Foundation of St Katharine, a religious charity in the East End of London. It traces its origins to a medieval church and monastic hospital, St Katharine's by the Tower, established in 1147 next to the Tower of London. Two notable people died here: John Beaufort, first Earl of Somerset, son of John of Gaunt, and William Rainsborough, a naval vice-admiral and ambassador to Morocco. Edward Montagu is buried here.
